title: Peru: dollarization of broad money and its foreign-currency part (1992-2026) and twelve-month consumer price inflation in Lima (1985-2026), monthly
source: Banco Central de Reserva del Perú, BCRPData (API)
series: PN00025MM, 'Liquidez de las sociedades creadoras de depósito (fin de periodo) - Coeficiente de Dolarización de la Liquidez (%)' (dollarization_pct); PN01273PM, 'Índice de precios Lima Metropolitana (var% 12 meses) - IPC' (cpi_12m_pct); PN00023MM and PN00024MM, 'Liquidez de las sociedades creadoras de depósito (fin de periodo) - Liquidez - ME' in millions of soles (fc_liq_msol) and millions of US dollars (fc_liq_musd)

citation: Fuente: Banco Central de Reserva del Perú (BCRPData), series PN00025MM, PN01273PM, PN00023MM y PN00024MM.
notes: Downloaded 2026-10-14. Dollarization: share of the liquidity (broad money) of the depository corporations held in foreign currency, end of month, January 1992 to August 2026. Inflation: change of the Lima consumer price index over twelve months, January 1985 to September 2026. Foreign-currency liquidity of the depository corporations, end of month, January 1992 to August 2026, in millions of soles and of dollars (added 2026-10-14 after the review): their ratio is the end-of-month exchange rate, which shows that the coefficient values the foreign-currency part at the current exchange rate. Values rounded to two decimals.
